name: week
title: The practice week
subtitle: Recorded deadlines, missing records and capacity

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select name,client,owner,reason,days from attention order by days desc,name

sections.title: Capacity
sections.sql: select name,weekly_hours,due_next_7_days_hours,overload_hours from workload order by name

sections.title: Budget against time
sections.sql: select name,client,currency,budget_hours,hours,fee,time_value,fee_less_time_value from job_summary order by name

sections.title: Family groups
sections.sql: select client_group,currency,sum(unbilled) as unbilled from job_summary group by client_group,currency order by client_group,currency
